id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

permissions.description: Rules that define the access controls for this Role

dataPermissions.description: Condition to be passed to specified actions, aka data access permissions

roles.description:
The {@link Role}s that are included with this Role.
If there are conflicting roles between nestedRoles and roles field, then the role defined in nestedRoles takes priority.
Permissions and resources granted to child roles are automatically granted to their parent roles.

nestedRoles.description:
The ids of the Roles that are included with this Role.
If there are conflicting roles between nestedRoles and roles field, then the role defined in nestedRoles takes priority.
Permissions and resources granted to child roles are automatically granted to their parent roles.

description.description: Human readable description of the Role

title:
Metadata type that represents the unit of access control in the C3 Platform.
It follows an env/app fetch hierarchy: env/app -> env/c3 -> c3/c3, i.e. when fetching Role objects in a given
env/app, objects from env/app + env/c3 + c3/c3 will be returned.

There are a handful of Roles defined as `seed` Roles which are not persisted and can only be accessed through the {@link Role#seed} action

@see security-roles-and-permissions.c3doc.md
